data.name: FirstRunTutorial.WelcomeDescription
data.value: This is a first-run guide that walks you through the core features of the main screen. You can skip it anytime.

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.AddModDescription
data.value: Click "Add Mod" on the left to import zip / 7z / rar / tar archives, or drag archives directly into this window. Click "Create Mod" to build your own mod.

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.ManageDescription
data.value: The top search box filters by name, pinyin, or @tag. Hold Ctrl and click mod cards to multi-select. Batch actions such as select all, enable/disable, tagging, grouping, and delete will then appear at the top.

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.CheckDescription
data.value: "Check Unit Version Compatibility" on the left scans whether mods match the current game build. "Refresh conflict check" detects mods that override the same armor resource.

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.DeployDescription
data.value: "Deploy Mods" numbers the enabled mods in the list and adds them to the game's data directory; the deployment order setting defaults to top-to-bottom. In other words, the last mod has the highest priority and overrides the previous ones. "Clean Mods" removes the mod files from the game's data directory when clicked. "Refresh Mods" rescans the manager's data folder for newly added mods (mainly used to restore mods from the recycle bin). "Launch HD2" starts the game through Steam.

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.BackgroundTasksDescription
data.value: Background tasks such as file hash calculation and compatibility checks show their progress here.

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.ArmorReuseDescription
data.value: Inspect and troubleshoot armor parts reused across multiple mods to help solve armor display or override issues.

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.PatchResourceViewerDescription
data.value: Not a very useful feature—you can directly view the texture files inside models.

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.BisectDescription
data.value: When unsure which mod causes an in-game issue, use bisect to quickly narrow down and locate the problematic mod (its reliability is questionable).

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.TagManagementDescription
data.value: Create and manage tags, then filter mods quickly with @tag in the dashboard search box.

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.SettingsDescription
data.value: Configure global options such as the game path, storage/temp directories, language, appearance, and logs.

data.name: FirstRunTutorial.FinishDescription
data.value: You now understand the main features. Import a mod and start deploying! If you want to watch the tutorial again later, open "Settings", go to the "Tools" tab, and you'll find the "Replay Tutorial" option.

data.name: VersionCheckDisclaimer.Message
data.value:
Mod repair rebuilds game resource structures, and automatic decisions cannot be guaranteed to work for every mod. A repaired mod may have invisible models, crash the equipment screen or game, or contain damaged files. HD2MM attempts to create backups, but you should also retain the original mod before repairing it.
Repaired mods are for your personal use only. Do not upload, share, resell, or redistribute them in any form. Rights to models, textures, and other assets remain with their original authors.
Selecting Confirm means that you understand and accept these risks and restrictions. This notice will not be shown again after acceptance.
